verdict.rationale: Sentry ships Seer, a built-in AI agent that can autonomously scan issues, root-cause them, review PRs, generate fixes, and answer telemetry questions (sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-30, sentry-docs-31, sentry-docs-33, sentry-docs-34), which is genuine in-product task delegation to an AI assistant. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Seer's delegation quality and reliability, clarity on which plans/tiers include full Seer agent access versus just MCP, and evidence of open-ended free-form task delegation beyond the predefined triage/review/fix workflows.
